title: Nehru Trophy Boat Race
description: The best-known snake-boat race in Kerala's backwaters.
date_note: Traditionally held in August. Confirm this year's date with the organisers.

title: Champions Boat League (CBL)
description: A series of snake-boat races held at different backwater venues.
date_note: Typically runs between August and November. Dates and venues vary each season.

title: Kerala Blasters FC home matches
description: Home games of Kerala's Indian Super League club.
date_note: Played through the ISL season. Check the official ISL fixture list for match dates.

title: Santosh Trophy
description: India's national football championship for state teams. Kerala fields a team every edition.
date_note: Dates and host state vary by edition.

title: Ranji Trophy (Kerala home matches)
description: Kerala's home fixtures in India's premier domestic first-class cricket tournament.
date_note: Played during the domestic season. Check the BCCI or Kerala Cricket Association schedule.

title: Kerala State School Sports Meet
description: The annual state-level sports meet for school students.
date_note: Usually held in the post-monsoon months. Check the General Education Department for dates.
